_source_note: Tool names and parameters are taken from real, publicly documented MCP servers (D3): the modelcontextprotocol/servers reference set plus widely-used vendor servers (Notion, Linear, Stripe, Supabase, Sentry, Atlassian, Playwright). Descriptions are condensed one-liners in the style each server publishes, and input schemas carry each tool's real parameter names with types trimmed to what a client would load. This is a hand-curated snapshot of public docs, not a live scrape (design.md, Non-Goals) — it is meant to be realistic and auditable, not byte-identical to any server's current release.
